messages:
sophia: Hey team — I'm planning to return at 75% FTE after parental leave (start 2026-10-04). I'm also arranging overnight childcare for 3 nights/week and want to confirm whether the childcare subsidy can cover overnight care, how subsidy proration works for 75%, payroll code to include, and if company can reimburse emergency overnight backup care.
people-ops: Congrats @sophia! :tada: Short answers: 1) Subsidy covers licensed overnight childcare in emergency/approved cases, 2) subsidy will be prorated to FTE (so 75% in your case), 3) use code PT75-2026 on the phased-return form so payroll ties deductions/allocations correctly, 4) emergency overnight backup is eligible as an exception — please submit receipts within 30 days. Fill the Return form: https://hr.redwood.example/phased-return and check "overnight-care" box.
sophia: Thanks — do I need pre-approval for a recurring overnight provider or just submit receipts after the fact? Also need nights covered on-call weeks 2-5.
people-ops: Recurring overnight providers require a one-time approval: upload the license and provider contact on the form. For one-off emergencies, receipts are fine. We'll flag on-call so alerts route to backup during your off hours.
ben: I can take nights for weeks 2 & 3 and pair with @michelle for weeks 4 & 5. Sophia, which nights are you planning?
sophia: Planning Tue/Wed/Thu overnight coverage (home-based) so I'm offline 20:00-08:00 those nights.
people-ops: Rota snippet you can paste in the on-call page: ```if user.fte < 1.0 and user.off_hours == "overnight" then route_to_backup(start=20:00, end=08:00)``` We'll also add a "overnight-care" badge to your profile.
michelle: Payroll note: PT75-2026 on the form. Subsidy calc will be monthly prorated to 75% of full subsidy. Emergency reimbursements are processed as taxable reimbursements; send receipts to payroll@redwood.example with code EMG-OVN. Equity vesting unaffected for temporary returns.
recruiting: If you want a short-term contractor to help with night triage, I can open a 0.25 FTE req focused on pageless work and release checks. ETA to shortlist ~2 weeks. Tagging people-ops for onboarding.
hr-bot: Reminder: submit the phased-return form and provider docs within 7 business days to guarantee subsidy setup before your return date.
sophia: Submitted form and uploaded provider license + PT75-2026. Marked nights as Tue/Wed/Thu. Also requested expedited equipment shipping for a small monitor since I'll be remote those days.
people-ops: Received. Equipment ETA 6 business days; we'll try to expedite and will confirm ship date here. Next steps checklist: 1) people-ops to confirm equipment ship date, 2) michelle to DM subsidy estimate, 3) ben/michelle to publish night rota, 4) recruiting to open contract req if desired. We'll update when items complete.
sophia: Amazing, thanks everyone :heart:
